authorization.statement: 126의 보정이 robot6에서의 depth 보정값이거든 이거와 연결해서 RBGD를 보정해서 코드를 수정해줘
authorization.scope: Apply robot6 PR126 depth correction locally before RGB-D XYZ; no hardware reconfiguration

limitations: Single 0.82 m measurement; multirange validation NOT_RUN
Distance correction does not establish RGB-depth spatial registration or capture synchronization
Sensor variance evidence for projection must describe the corrected coordinate output
